adapter: adapters/{tool}/ — pick the entry for your tool; see adapters/README.md
enforcement: enforcement/ — install for ALL tools (lefthook + CI)
toolHooks: adapters/{tool}/hooks/ if the tool supports them — an accelerator, never the only layer
$comment: Install `core` only. That is the default and it is deliberate.
`optional` entries are held back on purpose. A standards file nobody reads
still has to be kept current, and a stale standard is worse than a missing one
because it is trusted. Pull an optional file the first time the project
actually hits the problem it describes - not in advance.
To add one later, use standards.mjs add-module; it restores routing and updates the lock.

project.$comment: Copy the chosen preset to standards/project.json, then make every value explicit.

postInstall: Run the installation check; routing placeholders and uninstalled rows are handled by the installer.
Fill stack choices and commands in standards/project.json.

resident_optional.standards/core/optional/i18n.md: install only if the project is localized

optional.standards/reference/api-contracts.md: first API integration, or when adopting OpenAPI codegen
optional.standards/reference/performance-web.md: when a budget is set or a regression appears
optional.standards/reference/seo-gtm.md: promote early on a marketing or content site - SSR exists to be indexed
optional.standards/reference/observability.md: when adding error reporting, analytics, or flags

optional.workflows/review-pr.md: reviewing others' PRs, not just your own diff
optional.workflows/security-headers.md: promote early - Next has a server, so headers are yours to get wrong

excluded.standards/platform/native.md: inverts several web rules; loading both is incoherent
